verses.en: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.pt: Então todas as tribos de Israel vieram a Davi em Hebrom e disseram: Eis-nos aqui, teus ossos e tua carne!
verses.en_web: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron, and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.en_bbe: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David in Hebron and said, Truly, we are your bone and your flesh.

verses.en: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
verses.pt: Além disso, outrora, quando Saul ainda reinava sobre nós, eras tu o que saías e entravas com Israel; e também o Senhor te disse: Tu apascentarás o meu povo de Israel, e tu serás chefe sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”
verses.en_bbe: In the past when Saul was king over us, it was you who went at the head of Israel when they went out or came in: and the Lord said to you, You are to be the keeper of my people Israel and their ruler.

verses.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, todos os anciãos de Israel vieram ter com o rei em Hebrom; e o rei Davi fez aliança com eles em Hebrom, perante o Senhor; e ungiram a Davi rei sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and king David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So all the responsible men of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and King David made an agreement with them in Hebron before the Lord: and they put the holy oil on David and made him king over Israel.

verses.en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.pt: Trinta anos tinha Davi quando começou a reinar, e reinou quarenta anos.
verses.en_web: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.en_bbe: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he was king for forty years,

verses.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.pt: Em Hebrom reinou sete anos e seis meses sobre Judá, e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos sobre todo o Israel e Judá.
verses.en_web: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months; and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
verses.en_bbe: Ruling over Judah in Hebron for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem, over all Israel and Judah, for thirty-three years.

verses.en: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
verses.pt: Depois partiu o rei com os seus homens para Jerusalém, contra os jebuseus, que habitavam naquela terra, os quais disseram a Davi: Não entrarás aqui; os cegos e es coxos te repelirão; querendo dizer: Davi de maneira alguma entrará aqui.
verses.en_web: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here”; thinking, “David can’t come in here.”
verses.en_bbe: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the people of the land: and they said to David, You will not come in here, but the blind and the feeble-footed will keep you out; for they said, David will not be able to come in here.

verses.en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
verses.pt: Todavia Davi tomou a fortaleza de Sião; esta é a cidade de Davi.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.
verses.en_bbe: But David took the strong place of Zion, which is the town of David.

verses.en: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
verses.pt: Ora, Davi disse naquele dia: Todo o que ferir os jebuseus, suba ao canal, e fira a esses coxos e cegos, a quem a alma de Davi aborrece. Por isso se diz: Nem cego nem, coxo entrara na casa.
verses.en_web: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”
verses.en_bbe: And that day David said, Whoever makes an attack on the Jebusites, let him go up by the water-pipe, and put to death all the blind and feeble-footed who are hated by David. And this is why they say, The blind and feeble-footed may not come into the house.

verses.en: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
verses.pt: Assim habitou Davi na fortaleza, e chamou-a cidade de Davi; e foi levantando edifícios em redor, desde Milo para dentro.
verses.en_web: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.
verses.en_bbe: So David took the strong tower for his living-place, naming it the town of David. And David took in hand the building of the town all round, starting from the Millo.

verses.en: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.
verses.pt: Davi ia-se engrandecendo cada vez mais, porque o Senhor Deus dos exércitos era com ele.
verses.en_web: David grew greater and greater; for Yahweh, the God of Armies, was with him.
verses.en_bbe: And David became greater and greater; for the Lord, the God of armies, was with him.

verses.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
verses.pt: Hirão, rei de Tiro, enviou mensageiros a Davi, e madeira de cedro, e carpinteiros e pedreiros, que edificaram para Davi uma casa.
verses.en_web: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.
verses.en_bbe: And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent men to David, with cedar-trees and woodworkers and stoneworkers: and they made David a house.

verses.en: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
verses.pt: Entendeu, pois, Davi que o Senhor o confirmara rei sobre Israel, e que exaltara e reino dele por amar do seu povo Israel.
verses.en_web: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
verses.en_bbe: And David saw that the Lord had made his position safe as king over Israel, and that he had made his kingdom great because of his people Israel.

verses.en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
verses.pt: Davi tomou ainda para si concubinas e mulheres de Jerusalém, depois que viera de Hebrom; e nasceram a Davi mais filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
verses.en_bbe: And David took more women and wives in Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron: and he had more sons and daughters.

verses.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.pt: São estes os nomes dos que lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Samua, Sobabe, Natã, Salomão,
verses.en_web: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of those whose birth took place in Jerusalem: Shammua and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon

verses.en: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.pt: Ibar, Elisua, Nefegue, Jafia,
verses.en_web: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
verses.en_bbe: And Ibhar and Elishua and Nepheg and Japhia

verses.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.pt: Elisama, e Eliadá e Elifelete.
verses.en_web: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.en_bbe: And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet.

verses.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
verses.pt: Quando os filisteus ouviram que Davi fora ungido rei sobre Israel, subiram todos em busca dele. Ouvindo isto, Davi desceu à fortaleza.
verses.en_web: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
verses.en_bbe: And when the Philistines had news that David had been made king over Israel, they all went up in search of David; and David, hearing of it, went down to the strong place.

verses.en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.pt: Os filisteus vieram, e se estenderam pelo vale de Refaim.
verses.en_web: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.en_bbe: And when the Philistines came, they went in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.en: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
verses.pt: Pelo que Davi consultou ao Senhor, dizendo: Subirei contra os filisteus? entregar-mos-ás nas mãos? Respondeu o Senhor a Davi: Sobe, pois eu entregarei os filisteus nas tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
verses.en_bbe: And David, desiring directions from the Lord, said, Am I to go up against the Philistines? will you give them up into my hands? And the Lord said, Go up, for I will certainly give up the Philistines into your hands.

verses.en: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.pt: Então foi Davi a Baal-Perazim, e ali os derrotou; e disse: O Senhor rompeu os meus inimigos diante de mim, como as águas rompem barreiras. Por isso chamou o nome daquele lugar Baal-Perazim.
verses.en_web: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “Yahweh has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
verses.en_bbe: And David went to Baal-perazim, and overcame them there; and he said, The Lord has let the forces fighting against me be broken before me as a wall is broken by rushing waters. So that place was named Baal-perazim.

verses.en: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
verses.pt: Os filisteus deixaram lá os seus ídolos, e Davi e os seus homens os levaram.
verses.en_web: They left their images there; and David and his men took them away.
verses.en_bbe: And the Philistines, when they went in flight, did not take their images with them, and David and his men took them away.

verses.en: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.pt: Tornaram ainda os filisteus a subir, e se espalharam pelo vale de Refaim.
verses.en_web: The Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.en_bbe: And the Philistines came up again, and went in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.en: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.pt: E Davi consultou ao Senhor, que respondeu: Não subirás; mas rodeia-os por detrás, e virás sobre eles por defronte dos balsameiros.
verses.en_web: When David inquired of Yahweh, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.
verses.en_bbe: And when David went for directions to the Lord, he said, You are not to go up against them in front; but make a circle round them from the back and come on them opposite the spice-trees.

verses.en: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.pt: E há de ser que, ouvindo tu o ruído de marcha pelas copas dos balsameiros, então te apressarás, porque é o Senhor que sai diante de ti, a ferir o arraial dos filisteus.
verses.en_web: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
verses.en_bbe: Then at the sound of footsteps in the tops of the trees, go forward quickly, for the Lord has gone out before you to overcome the army of the Philistines.

verses.en: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
verses.pt: Fez, pois, Davi como o Senhor lhe havia ordenado; e feriu os filisteus desde Geba, até chegar a Gezer.
verses.en_web: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
verses.en_bbe: And David did as the Lord had said; and he overcame the Philistines, attacking them from Gibeon to near Gezer.
